stories.headline: Blue Origin's New Glenn explodes in static-fire test, days before first Amazon Leo launch

key_facts.fact: A Blue Origin New Glenn first-stage booster nicknamed 'No, It's Necessary' exploded during a static fire test at Launch Complex 36, Cape Canaveral, shortly after 9 p.m. EDT on May 28, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: A Blue Origin New Glenn rocket exploded on its launchpad during a static test fire May 28 ahead of the company's fourth orbital flight... shortly after 9 pm EDT at Cape Canaveral SFS Space Launch Complex-36 (SLC-36).

key_facts.fact: The rocket was being prepared to launch 48 Amazon Leo broadband satellites as soon as the following week; the satellites were not aboard during the test.
key_facts.excerpt: The 322-foot-tall rocket... had been due to send 48 Amazon Leo satellites into orbit as soon as next week... The satellites were not aboard the rocket for the test.

key_facts.fact: The blast severely damaged the pad and toppled a lightning-protection tower; Space Launch Delta 45 reported no injuries or fatalities.
key_facts.excerpt: The brand new booster and its second stage were lost in the explosion. Also, one of LC-36's lightning protection towers was seen falling over after the incident... Space Launch Delta 45 reports no injuries or fatalities from the incident.

key_facts.fact: The FAA had cleared New Glenn to return to flight last week after investigating an April 19 upper-stage failure that left AST SpaceMobile's BlueBird 7 satellite in the wrong orbit.
key_facts.excerpt: The company announced New Glenn's plans to return to flight earlier this week after a failure during the rocket's third flight on April 19 prompted a Federal Aviation Administration investigation... the upper portion... didn't manage to deliver its payload — AST SpaceMobile's BlueBird 7 satellite — to a safe orbit.

key_facts.fact: Blue Origin said all personnel were accounted for after the 'anomaly,' and NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman pledged support for a thorough investigation.
key_facts.excerpt: 'NASA is aware of the anomaly that occurred tonight at Launch Complex 36...' NASA chief Jared Isaacman said on X. 'Spaceflight is unforgiving... We will work with our partners to support a thorough investigation of this anomaly...'

key_facts.fact: LC-36 is the only launchpad built for the heavy-lift New Glenn and must be repaired before the rocket can return to flight.
key_facts.excerpt: Space Launch Complex 36 is the only facility built to launch the heavy-lift New Glenn rocket, and the pad will need to be repaired before Blue Origin can return to flight.

stories.headline: SpaceX lowers IPO valuation target to at least $1.8 trillion, down from $2T-plus

key_facts.fact: SpaceX is targeting a valuation of at least $1.8 trillion in its IPO, down from the $2 trillion-plus it sought as recently as April, after consultations with advisers and investors.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX is currently targeting a valuation of at least $1.8 trillion in its initial public offering... Bloomberg News reported in April that SpaceX was aiming for a valuation above $2 trillion. The target is settling lower after consultations with advisers and investors.

key_facts.fact: The company is seeking to raise as much as $75 billion, which would make it the biggest IPO of all time.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX is seeking to raise as much as $75 billion, people familiar with the matter have said, which would make it the biggest IPO of all time.

key_facts.fact: Roadshow marketing is expected to begin as soon as June 4, with pricing as early as June 11; the company plans to trade on Nasdaq under the symbol SPCX.
key_facts.excerpt: Marketing begins as soon as 4 June with pricing as early as 11 June... The company expects to make its debut on Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas under the symbol SPCX.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX reported $18.7 billion in 2025 revenue (up from $14 billion in 2024) but swung to a roughly $4.94 billion loss after acquiring xAI.
key_facts.excerpt: The company reported $18.7 billion in 2025 revenue but swung to a $4.94 billion loss after acquiring xAI.

key_facts.fact: At $1.8 trillion, SpaceX would trade at roughly 96 times its 2025 revenue and rank among the world's most valuable companies, trailing only Apple, Nvidia, Microsoft and Alphabet.
key_facts.excerpt: At $1.8 trillion, SpaceX would be valued at roughly 96 times its 2025 revenue... larger than Amazon and trailing only Apple, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Alphabet.

key_facts.fact: Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, Citigroup and JPMorgan are leading the IPO alongside 18 other banks, with an unusually large 30% retail-investor allocation.
key_facts.excerpt: Goldman Sachs Group Inc., Morgan Stanley, Bank of America Corp., Citigroup Inc. and JPMorgan Chase & Co. are leading the IPO along with 18 other banks.

stories.headline: Wix cuts about 1,000 jobs (20% of staff), CEO citing AI shift and strong shekel

key_facts.fact: Wix is laying off roughly 20% of its workforce — about 1,000 employees — in the largest round of cuts in the Israeli company's history, CEO Avishai Abrahami announced Thursday.
key_facts.excerpt: Wix founder, partner and CEO Avishai Abrahami confirmed Thursday that the company will lay off 20% of its workforce, about 1,000 employees, in the largest round of cuts in the Israeli company's history.

key_facts.fact: Wix had 5,277 employees at the end of Q1 2026, with more than 60% based in Israel.
key_facts.excerpt: Wix had a headcount of 5,277 employees at the end of the first quarter and the job cuts equate to around 1,000 people.

key_facts.fact: Abrahami cited the rapid evolution of AI and a strengthening shekel, which has appreciated nearly 30% against the dollar over the past year to a 33-year peak, squeezing the mostly shekel-denominated cost base against dollar revenue.
key_facts.excerpt: The shekel has appreciated nearly 30% against the dollar over the last year to reach a 33-year peak... 'a very meaningful portion of our costs are shekel-denominated, while our revenue is largely dollar-denominated.'

key_facts.fact: Abrahami framed AI as a structural shift, writing it was 'the most significant shift in how companies are built since the invention of modern programming languages in the 1970s,' and said Wix will move to fewer management layers.
key_facts.excerpt: 'We have witnessed the most significant shift in how companies are built since the invention of modern programming languages in the 1970s,' Abrahami wrote... The company is also moving toward a flatter structure with fewer management layers.

key_facts.fact: Wix shares have fallen nearly 50% since the start of the year; the company, once valued at around $20 billion, is now worth roughly $2 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: a near 50% decline in its stock price since the start of the... The company, once valued at around $20 billion, is now worth roughly $2 billion.

key_facts.fact: The company is reorganizing around AI-native roles such as 'Xengineer' and 'Creators' and is building its own AI model to power its Harmony website-building system.
key_facts.excerpt: Wix, he added, is already reorganizing around that shift, including new roles such as Xengineer and Creators designed for 'AI-native ways of working.'

stories.headline: Sweden to sell Ukraine up to 20 new Gripen E jets and donate 16 older C/D models

key_facts.fact: At a joint press conference at Uppsala Air Base on May 28, Sweden's PM Ulf Kristersson and Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine intends to acquire an initial batch of up to 20 new Gripen E/F fighters and Sweden intends to donate up to 16 older Gripen C/D.
key_facts.excerpt: Sweden's Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson and Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced today that Ukraine intends to acquire an initial batch of up to 20 Gripen E/F and that Sweden intends to donate up to 16 Gripen C/D to Ukraine.

key_facts.fact: Ukraine plans to allocate 2.5 billion euros ($2.9 billion) from a 90 billion-euro EU support loan to fund the new aircraft.
key_facts.excerpt: Stockholm said that Kyiv plans to allocate 2.5 billion euros ($2.9 billion) from the European Union's Ukraine Support Loan to fund the package for the more modern Gripen combat aircraft.

key_facts.fact: The 16 donated Gripen C/D aircraft are due to be delivered in early 2027, while deliveries of the newer Gripen E are expected from 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: Ukraine will buy 20 new Gripen fighter jets and Sweden will donate 16 of an older model next year... Deliveries of the new model are expected to reach Ukraine from 2030.

key_facts.fact: The deal builds on an October 2025 letter of intent for Ukraine to acquire up to 150 Gripen E jets, a purchase that would make Ukraine the world's second-largest Gripen operator by fleet size.
key_facts.excerpt: which Ukraine signed a letter of intent in October 2025 — could become the largest single order in Saab's history... which would make it the world's second-largest Gripen operator by fleet size.

key_facts.fact: The donated aircraft come with weapons packages including missiles with a range exceeding 200 kilometers (124 miles).
key_facts.excerpt: Ukraine will receive the Swedish aircraft together with weapons packages, including missiles with a range exceeding 200 kilometers (124 miles).

key_facts.fact: Saab said it has not yet signed any contract nor received an order, with negotiations on Ukraine's Gripen E acquisition still to be completed.
key_facts.excerpt: At this point Saab has not signed any contract nor received an order relating to this.

stories.headline: US Q1 GDP revised down to 1.6% as sticky inflation cements no Fed cuts in 2026

key_facts.fact: US real GDP rose at a 1.6% annual rate in Q1 2026 (second estimate), revised down 0.4 percentage point from the advance estimate, versus a 0.5% increase in Q4 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Real gross domestic product (GDP) increased at an annual rate of 1.6 percent in the first quarter of 2026... In the fourth quarter of 2025, real GDP increased 0.5 percent. Real GDP was revised down 0.4 percentage point from the advance estimate.

key_facts.fact: The downward revision primarily reflected weaker investment and consumer spending.
key_facts.excerpt: a downward revision of 0.4 percentage point from the previous estimate, primarily reflecting downward revisions to investment and consumer spending.

key_facts.fact: The Q1 PCE price index rose 4.5%, with the core PCE price index (excluding food and energy) up 4.4%, revised up 0.1 percentage point.
key_facts.excerpt: The personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index increased 4.5 percent... and the PCE price index excluding food and energy increased 4.4 percent, revised up 0.1 percentage point.

key_facts.fact: Corporate profits rose $40.4 billion in Q1, far below the $246.9 billion gain in Q4 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Profits from current production... increased $40.4 billion in... quarter, compared with an increase of $246.9 billion in the fourth quarter of 2025.

key_facts.fact: The data and hawkish Fed remarks consolidated market expectations of no rate cuts in 2026; St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem warned that relying on future AI-driven productivity gains to tame inflation poses 'extremely high policy risks.'
key_facts.excerpt: it consolidated market views that the Federal Reserve will not cut interest rates this year... relying on the prospect of future productivity gains to address current inflation poses extremely high policy risks.

stories.headline: UN climate agency: 75% chance the next five years breach 1.5C, smashing heat records

key_facts.fact: The World Meteorological Organization and UK Met Office project a 75% chance that the average global temperature in 2026-2030 will exceed 1.5C above pre-industrial levels, the Paris Agreement threshold.
key_facts.excerpt: there's a 75% chance that the average global temperature between 2026 and 2030 will exceed 1.5 degrees Celsius (2.7 degrees Fahrenheit) since pre-industrial times. That threshold is the agreed-upon limit of warming... set in 2015 by the Paris climate agreement.

key_facts.fact: There is a 91% chance at least one of the next five years individually breaches 1.5C, and an 86% chance one of them surpasses 2024's record as the hottest year ever measured.
key_facts.excerpt: There is also a 91 per cent chance that at least one of the next five years will breach that mark individually, and an 86 per cent chance that one of those years will surpass 2024's record as the hottest year ever measured.

key_facts.fact: The projection also forecasts the Arctic warming nearly 1.66C (3F) between now and 2030 and a dangerous drought with potential wildfires for the Amazon.
key_facts.excerpt: The World Meteorological Organization also forecasts an overheating Arctic that warms nearly 3 degrees Fahrenheit (1.66 degrees Celsius) between now and 2030 and a dangerous drought with potential wildfires for the Amazon.

key_facts.fact: UN climate chief Simon Stiell called the report and Europe's heatwave a 'brutal reminder of the spiralling impacts of the climate crisis,' urging a faster shift to clean power.
key_facts.excerpt: Simon Stiell, the Executive Secretary of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCC), describes the unprecedented heatwave as a 'brutal reminder of the spiralling impacts of the climate crisis.'

key_facts.fact: The projections landed as a heat dome pushed record May temperatures across Europe and temperatures in Rajasthan, India hit 48.2C.
key_facts.excerpt: temperatures in Rajasthan soared to 48.2C on Wednesday and heatwave conditions gripped large parts of northern and central India.

stories.headline: IEA warns of 'largest energy security crisis ever' as Hormuz war reshapes investment

key_facts.fact: In its World Energy Investment 2026 report published Thursday, the IEA said the world is in 'the largest energy security crisis' in history as the Middle East war forces countries to scramble for new supply routes.
key_facts.excerpt: 'We are in the midst of the largest energy security crisis the world has ever faced -- and I believe this will reshape investment strategies globally, with parallels to the major changes the energy world witnessed after the oil shocks of the 1970s,' said IEA executive director Fatih Birol in the agency's latest World Energy Investment report.

key_facts.fact: IEA chief Fatih Birol compared the situation to the structural changes triggered by the 1970s oil shocks, saying disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz have significantly changed global risk perceptions.
key_facts.excerpt: Birol compared the current situation to the structural changes triggered by the oil crises of the 1970s... the effective closure and disruption risks around the Strait of Hormuz — a route through which nearly one-fifth of global oil trade passes — have significantly changed global risk perceptions.

key_facts.fact: The IEA estimated global energy investment would rise to $3.4 trillion in 2026, while oil-production investment is expected to fall for a third consecutive year, slipping below $500 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: global energy investment would rise to $3.4 trillion in 2026... investment in oil production is expected to decline for the third consecutive year in 2026, slipping below $500 billion.

key_facts.fact: The crisis is accelerating investment in renewables, electricity grids, LNG, nuclear power and domestic energy sources as countries diversify away from imported fuels.
key_facts.excerpt: The IEA says the latest shock is accelerating investments in renewables, electricity grids, LNG, nuclear power, and domestic energy sources.

key_facts.fact: Birol separately warned Euronews that easing sanctions on Russian energy would be a 'major mistake'; turmoil in the Middle East has contributed to a 65% rise in oil prices and a more-than-doubling of gas prices, per European Commission estimates.
key_facts.excerpt: Easing sanctions on Russian energy would be a 'major mistake'... The turmoil in the Middle East has contributed to a 65% increase in oil prices, according to the European Commission's own estimates. Meanwhile, gas prices have more than doubled.
